title: The Bakery of Bellbird Bay Again
author: Freya Underhill
blurb: Freya Oyelaran, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
